The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, the process comprising the following steps: the starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate undergoes an ester cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance to give a 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt; the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or alternatively the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid. In the preparation process provided by the present invention a tertiary alcohol is used as the solvent and the starting material undergoes the ester cleavage reaction in the presence of a basic substance, which lowers the content of impurities; the yield and the quality of the target compound are greatly raised, which provides a safeguard for the final synthesis of high quality tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material.
